notes: In VS Code, your kit now wakes on its own at the start of a chat instead of waiting to be asked. It was the one editor we never gave a guidance note to, so nothing ever told Copilot your kit was there to wake.

Waking your kit no longer fails in VS Code and Copilot with an "invalid parameter format" error. The assistant phrases the request slightly differently there, and we were being stricter than we needed to be.
